desc_en: This sleeveless mini dress redefines minimalist elegance with its straight-cut silhouette. Crafted from a lightweight and smooth fabric, it offers a fluid and comfortable wearing experience. The design features a refined round neckline and a discreet hidden zipper at the back that maintains a clean and immaculate aesthetic. Its mid-thigh length brings a timeless and versatile charm, ideal for any sophisticated occasion. Each piece is made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Este minivestido sin mangas redefine la elegancia minimalista con su silueta de corte recto. Confeccionado con un tejido ligero y suave, ofrece una experiencia de uso fluida y cómoda. El diseño presenta un refinado cuello redondo y una sutil cremallera oculta en la espalda que mantiene una estética limpia e impecable. Su caída a media pierna aporta un encanto atemporal y versátil, ideal para cualquier ocasión sofisticada. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido y cuenta con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: 100% polyester
· Straight-cut silhouette with round neckline
· Hidden zipper closure at the back
· Hand or machine wash at a maximum of 45ºC
· Made-to-order piece with worldwide shipping
